limitations.note: The patch fixed counting on idle cycles but also made `ready_a` high during reset and changed `valid_b` to pulse only on the sixth accepted bit, instead of preserving the original registered `cnt == 5` behavior during gaps.
The test exercised gaps and reset but expected the rewrite's always-high `ready_a` and sixth-bit-only `valid_b` pulse, so it passed without catching either change from the required behavior.
